answer: Mechanism: stake-locked VRF registration. Each identity commits a fixed stake for one epoch and, after the beacon reveals, generates a per-epoch "relic" from that stake. A "violet" threshold admits only those with stake above the median. Attacker cost: per fake identity, full stake plus forfeited yield; N sybils costs N×stake, no bulk discount. Sparrow is the local verification: check the VRF proof instantly without chain query.
